tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The window's ground: the chassis page around the cards. Text on it: ink, t2, hint. Not value-ink, marker, celebrate or a corner's text ink (4.3-4.5:1 here on cream).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Module cards, the screen frame's chassis, pills and knob caps.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Data surfaces: visualisers, pads, keyboards. Lighter than its card on cream, darker on dark: recessed reads by contrast direction.

tokens.name: well-alt
tokens.usage: Control tracks, empty meter wells, the screen bezel, the rack ground. Text on it: ink and t2 only (hint is 4.19:1 light, 3.94:1 dark here).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Every outline (1.5 px) and primary text. 14.0-17.9:1 light and 12.0-16.4:1 dark on every ground.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: In-well gridlines only, never card borders. Decorative structure that carries no meaning (1.0-1.5:1 by design).

tokens.name: div
tokens.usage: Dashed separators inside a card. Decorative (1.2-1.7:1 by design).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: an alias of ink.

tokens.name: t2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, inactive tabs, idle pills. 7.4-9.5:1 light, 7.2-9.8:1 dark on every ground.

tokens.name: hint
tokens.usage: Hint text (mono 9-9.5 px) on bg, panel and well: 4.60, 5.14, 5.36:1 light; 5.09, 4.63, 5.36:1 dark. Never on well-alt. CHANGED by ADR-259 ruling 8: the UI Spec's #9a93a3 read 2.84:1 on panel.

tokens.name: dis
tokens.usage: Disabled text and controls only, at 0.55 opacity with no shadow. Exempt from the text floor (an inactive control); never use it for live information.

tokens.name: value
tokens.usage: The user's authored value outside the morph knob: the XY puck, curves, toggles that are on. A fill and line colour on cream (3.28 bg, 3.67 panel, 3.83 well); as text on cream use value-ink. Dark: text on bg, panel and well too (5.2-6.0). Knob and slider value arcs are neutral ink (the morph knob spec), because corner B's pip is pink.

tokens.name: physics
tokens.usage: The system acting: order parameter, K vector, modulation spans and the live mod tick, the link pill. Text and line safe: 5.06-6.48:1 light, 4.64-6.30:1 dark.

tokens.name: meter
tokens.usage: Analysers, honesty bars, the R rim, as a FILL. On cream it reads 1.44-1.85:1, so a meter line or meter text there uses meter-ink. Dark: lines and text (10.1-13.8:1).

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Attention: root star, overshoot, lock front, the first-over ring. Light is gui2's legibility darkening of the spec's #ffd702. Text on panel and well (4.86, 5.07); lines on every ground (3.96 or more).

tokens.name: celebrate
tokens.usage: OK: meter fill in the green, active state dots, the load bar. Light is gui2's darkening of #a6f219. Text on panel and well (4.90, 5.11); fills and lines everywhere (3.99 or more).

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: The caution banner's edge and the solo-engaged fill. Never text or a meaning-carrying line on cream (1.6-2.1:1); caution text is caution-tx.

tokens.name: caution-bg
tokens.usage: The caution banner's ground (PROVISIONAL, departures, owed honesty bars).

tokens.name: caution-tx
tokens.usage: Text on caution-bg: 5.80:1 light, 8.16:1 dark.

tokens.name: alarm
tokens.usage: PANIC, clip, the mute stamp, a latched over. Nothing else, and at most twice on a page. Text and line safe: 4.57-5.86:1 light, 4.64-6.30:1 dark.

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: The dry or reference trace drawn behind the wet one. It recedes by design (1.3-1.7:1 light, 2.0-2.7:1 dark). FLAGGED, kept as the source's: the wet trace carries the information, so a ghost is never the only carrier of a state.

tokens.name: value-ink
tokens.usage: Value as text or a thin line on cream: 4.94 panel, 5.16 well (4.42 on bg: no value text on bg). Also the light focus ring and the meter's peak hold (4.03 on well-alt). ADDED by ruling 8 from the ORCHID scheme; dark uses value.

tokens.name: meter-ink
tokens.usage: Meter as a line or text on cream: lines on every ground (4.07 or more), text on panel and well (4.99, 5.21). ADDED by ruling 8 from ORCHID; dark uses meter.

tokens.name: on-corner
tokens.usage: Glyphs and text on a corner fill or a light signal fill, in BOTH themes: 12.8:1 on A, 5.12 on B, 9.7 on C, 13.1 on D. From the Sluice lab's followed-corner chip. CHANGED: the spec put white text on B (3.50:1).

tokens.name: mark-edge
tokens.usage: The thin outline round a knob's corner pips, mod origin dots and a slider thumb: dark ink on cream, the panel colour on dark (the morph knob spec's dark outline).

tokens.name: src-env
tokens.usage: Envelope sources (ENV 1-4): mod rings and lanes, the MAP button and the source chip. Lines on every ground (4.34 bg, 4.85 panel light; 7.9 dark); on-src text on it. ADDED with the map mode spec; the human to confirm.

tokens.name: src-lfo
tokens.usage: LFO and modulator sources. 4.42 bg, 4.94 panel light; 6.2 dark. ADDED; the human to confirm.

tokens.name: src-macro
tokens.usage: Macros and the intent bus. 4.57 bg, 5.11 panel light; 6.5 dark. ADDED; the human to confirm.

tokens.name: src-engine
tokens.usage: Engine observables (R, phase, onset burst, gravity, velocity, expressions). 5.85 bg, 6.54 panel light; 6.5 dark. ADDED; FLAGGED: the closest pair is this and src-env (OKLab 0.105 cream, 0.097 dark), told apart by lightness and the caption.

tokens.name: on-src
tokens.usage: Text on a source fill (the lit MAP button): 4.85-6.54 light, 6.2-8.7 dark.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text on an alarm fill (the engaged mute, a latched CLIP lamp): 5.25:1 light; dark uses bg (5.99:1), the mixer lab's dark fix.

tokens.name: dusk-physics

tokens.name: dusk-marker

groups.name: Chassis
groups.note: Archivo (OFL), the UI Spec's face (ADR-259 ruling 1). Weights 500, 600 and 800. The plugin bundles the TTFs; nothing loads at runtime.

styles.name: cluster
styles.usage: Card and cluster headings, always UPPERCASE, in ink.

styles.name: option
styles.usage: Option names on canvas cards only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels and tabs, 10-11 px, in t2. An active tab sets it at 600 on an ink fill.

styles.name: label-knob
styles.usage: A knob's label. A sized knob (Density ladder) sets it ABOVE the face on one line with an ellipsis, and the value replaces it on hover; the classic knob sets it under the face, clamped at two lines. The full name is always the accessible name.

styles.name: sublabel
styles.usage: A sub-group's label inside a section (CUT, MIRROR, FM, SPREAD), always UPPERCASE, in hint (5.1:1 on panel cream, 4.6:1 or more dark). It replaces a boxed card for a cluster of two to six controls.

groups.name: Readouts
groups.note: Roboto Mono (OFL), tabular figures. Floors: no text below 8 px anywhere; no readout below 9.5 px.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Value readouts, 9.5-11 px, in ink, right-aligned in a 34-58 px column. Double-click opens typed entry.

styles.name: sticker
styles.usage: Text inside pills and enum stickers (8.5-10 px).

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Hints and captions in hint, line height 1.5-1.65.

spacing.note: No grid: exact values from the UI Spec §3 and the 980×720 chassis (the SCALPEL lab's frame).

tokens.name: space-row
tokens.usage: Row baseline and the hit floor (ADR-259 ruling 8).

tokens.name: space-row-mod
tokens.usage: A row whose slider shows its mod band.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a row (UI Spec 8-12).

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards at the spec window.

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Page padding at the spec window.

tokens.name: space-card-y
tokens.usage: Card padding, top and bottom (spec).

tokens.name: space-card-x
tokens.usage: Card padding, left and right (spec).

tokens.name: space-chassis-y
tokens.usage: The 980×720 frame's padding, top and bottom; also the screen bezel's padding.

tokens.name: space-chassis-x
tokens.usage: The 980×720 frame's padding, left and right.

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Between stacked cells in a 980×720 column, and between the frame's header and body.

tokens.name: space-column
tokens.usage: Between the 980×720 page's two columns; a cell's side padding.

tokens.name: space-cell-y
tokens.usage: A 980×720 cell's top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-dense
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). Between controls inside one sub-group: knob cells, pills, a slider row's columns.

tokens.name: space-subgroup
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). Each side of the dashed hairline between two sub-groups (CUT | MIRROR | FM), so groups sit 15 px apart.

tokens.name: space-head
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). Between a section header's line and its sub-groups.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). Between two sections stacked in one cell; the identity rule sits in it.

radius.note: One roundness for cards, wells and screens (the human, 2026-08-24); capsules are a shape, not a radius.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, wells, the screen bezel and glass, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: The plugin window and an FX screen's chassis.

tokens.name: radius-meter
tokens.usage: Meter bars, the latch lamp, slider handles.

tokens.name: radius-fader
tokens.usage: Fader caps.

tokens.name: radius-track
tokens.usage: Slider tracks, badges, matrix cells, tags.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Piano keys and dominoes (inside an 8 px clip).

tokens.name: radius-capsule
tokens.usage: Pills, tabs, toggles, text fields, corner chips.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows on interactive elements only; no blur anywhere; never on wells or text.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: An interactive element at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Hover: the cap lifts.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed or dragging: flat.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus, outside the ink edge, only in keyboard mode. CHANGED: the spec's 45% value ring read 1.9-2.0:1; now solid value-ink on cream (4.03-5.16:1 on every ground) and solid value on dark (4.43-6.02:1).

size.note: Sizes from the UI Spec §3-4, the labs and the window ruling.

tokens.name: size-window-w
tokens.usage: The plugin window's default width; resizable (ADR-259 ruling 2).

tokens.name: size-window-h
tokens.usage: The plugin window's default height.

tokens.name: size-drag
tokens.usage: A vertical drag of this length is the full range (the morph knob and map mode specs; shift is a quarter). Replaces the UI Spec's 200 px.

tokens.name: size-hit
tokens.usage: The smallest hit target, both ways. A smaller face extends its hit box; two targets never sit closer than 28 px apart.

tokens.name: size-knob
tokens.usage: The standard knob.

tokens.name: size-knob-big
tokens.usage: The big knob: a face's main controls and macros.

tokens.name: size-knob-dense
tokens.usage: A dense rack face.

tokens.name: size-knob-cap
tokens.usage: The knob's cap.

tokens.name: size-knob-box
tokens.usage: The morph knob's drawing box: the morph knob spec's 92-unit viewBox at 0.74 px a unit, so its track matches the 36 px knob and its rings and pips fit outside it.

tokens.name: size-knob-box-big
tokens.usage: The big morph knob's box (0.91 px a unit).

tokens.name: size-knob-halo
tokens.usage: The modulation halo ring.

tokens.name: size-knob-owned
tokens.usage: The dashed ring of a morph-owned knob, outside the halo.

tokens.name: size-slider-track
tokens.usage: Slider track height.

tokens.name: size-slider-handle
tokens.usage: Slider handle.

tokens.name: size-toggle-w
tokens.usage: Toggle face width.

tokens.name: size-toggle-h
tokens.usage: Toggle face height; its hit box is 28 px tall.

tokens.name: size-meter-w
tokens.usage: One meter bar.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: A corner chip, a circle never stretched.

tokens.name: size-strip
tokens.usage: A module card's corner strip.

tokens.name: size-puck
tokens.usage: The XY puck (16-18).

tokens.name: size-logo-w
tokens.usage: The wordmark's box in the 980×720 header.

tokens.name: size-logo-h
tokens.usage: The wordmark's box height.

tokens.name: size-glass-w
tokens.usage: A screen's logical width (GBC and the house glass).

tokens.name: size-glass-h
tokens.usage: A screen's logical height.

tokens.name: size-ws-glass-w
tokens.usage: The 80s workstation glass's logical width.

tokens.name: size-ws-glass-h
tokens.usage: The workstation glass's logical height.

tokens.name: size-title-slot-w
tokens.usage: A screen's TITLE logo slot.

tokens.name: size-title-slot-h
tokens.usage: The TITLE slot's height.

tokens.name: size-icon-slot
tokens.usage: A screen's ICON logo slot.

tokens.name: size-text-floor
tokens.usage: No text is smaller, anywhere.

tokens.name: size-readout-floor
tokens.usage: No readout is smaller.

tokens.name: size-knob-primary
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). PRIMARY morph knob's face box: macros and a page's one to three headline controls (Volume, Members). Tight geometry; the value always shows under it.

tokens.name: size-knob-standard
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). STANDARD morph knob's face box: a section's main controls where the panel is not dense. Tight geometry, label above, value on hover.

tokens.name: size-knob-compact
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). COMPACT morph knob's face box, the default inside a dense panel (oscillator, blade, filter): track about 27 px across, four mod rings 1.3 px apart, label above, value on hover. The SCALPEL bench's 36 px knob plus ring room.

tokens.name: size-knob-utility
tokens.usage: The Density ladder (README, Density and hierarchy; B589). UTILITY morph knob's face box: trims inside a row, a dashboard card, a header. Label inline to its left; one mod ring (the focused mapping's, dashed when there are more). The face is the 28 px hit target.

tokens.name: size-knob-tiny
tokens.usage: The tiny tier (ADR-338 r1, drawn as T2d by ADR-340 r1): a 20 px morph-knob face in a size-hit (28 px) cell, for P1's page-in-view grid. A see-through pip at the editing corner's value cuts the arc between two ink end stops; the arc is the blend, the needle the output, one ring the focused mapping. Its label is layout.json's abbreviation and never changes; the value goes to the section's readout slot (size-rslot).

tokens.name: size-slider-tiny
tokens.usage: TS1a (ADR-338 r3, ADR-340 r2): a 20 px slider row for route depths and amounts, dragging 1:1 with its drawn track. A NAMED EXCEPTION to size-hit on its cross axis only: its drag axis is its full width.

tokens.name: size-slider-cell
tokens.usage: TS2a (ADR-338 r3, ADR-340 r2): a 16 px table value cell, the fill the blend, the editing corner a see-through cut. A NAMED EXCEPTION to size-hit on its cross axis only: its drag axis is the cell's full width.

tokens.name: size-rslot
tokens.usage: H1 (ADR-340 r4): a section's readout slot is this wide whatever it says, truncating, so a hover or a drag never moves the header or the controls beside it.

tokens.name: size-cell-primary
tokens.usage: The column a primary knob owns: label line, face, value line. Replaces the classic knob's fixed 96 px readout cell.

tokens.name: size-cell-standard
tokens.usage: The column a standard knob owns: label line and face.

tokens.name: size-cell-compact
tokens.usage: The column a compact knob owns: label line and face (the bench's 46 px cell). Packed knobs sit at 52 px pitch with space-dense.

tokens.name: size-label-dense
tokens.usage: A dense slider row's label column (the classic row's is 72 px).

tokens.name: size-face-dense
tokens.usage: The visible face of a pill, stepper, readout, lamp or mute/solo button in a dense panel. Its hit box stays size-hit (28): an invisible box extends it, and wrapped rows keep 28 px pitch.

tokens.name: size-toggle-dense-w
tokens.usage: A dense toggle's face width (the bench's checkbox was 30).

tokens.name: size-toggle-dense-h
tokens.usage: A dense toggle's face height; its hit box is 28 px tall, like every toggle.

tokens.name: size-strip-w
tokens.usage: One mixer channel strip's width: its on toggle beside a five-letter name, the peak readout beside its CLIP lamp, the fader beside its meter pair, mute and solo at 28 px pitch under them.

tokens.name: size-fader-h
tokens.usage: A channel strip's fader length (the vertical slider's drawing; its track is 90% of it, and the meter beside it matches the track).

tokens.name: size-meter-w-dense
tokens.usage: One meter bar inside a channel strip (the stand-alone Meter keeps size-meter-w, 10).

tokens.name: stroke-sub

tokens.name: stroke-page

tokens.name: stroke-focus

tokens.name: stroke-id
tokens.usage: A section's identity rule above its header (ink; solid, dash or dot tells sections apart, never a colour).

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: A muted or bypassed region, with its tilted muted sticker.

tokens.name: opacity-halo

tokens.name: opacity-env-fill

tokens.name: opacity-hatch
tokens.usage: The 45° hatch of a DSP-clamped zone.

tokens.name: opacity-clip-zone
tokens.usage: The meter's top 8%, always tinted alarm.

tokens.usage: The least spacing between queued flips.
